facts.business: Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of sugar, generation of power, and production of alcohol/ethanol.
key_risks: Fluctuations in sugar prices and government policies affecting the sugar industry
Dependence on monsoon for sugarcane availability
Regulatory risks related to statutory levies (Excise Duty, Service Tax, Electricity taxes) under dispute
Interest rate risk on gratuity plan obligations
Investment risk on plan assets for defined benefit obligations
facts.related_party_note: The Company has entered into transactions with related parties in compliance with the provisions of Sections 177 and 188 of the Act. The details of such related party transactions have been disclosed in the Ind AS financial statements as required under Ind AS 24, Related Party Disclosures.
